Name: Builder Assistant 建筑助手
Description: Android-first Builder Assistant. v0.6.2 fixes the on-device false '区块未加载' abort: the game-adapter was hard-gating editability on TerrainChunk.IsLoaded, but x25.01.17 keeps IsLoaded=false even for chunks the player is standing on and raycasting into (it tracks disk/stream state, not writability), so a perfectly valid build site under the crosshair was classified ChunkNotLoaded and the build aborted with 470/470 cells 'not ready'. The gateway now treats editability as `chunk.State == Valid AND chunk.Cells != null` (the engine's own pipeline-terminal signal), records IsLoaded for the log but never gates on it, renames the misleading 'ChunkNotLoaded' status to 'ChunkContentsNotReady' with Chinese label '区块内容未就绪', and prints the real chunk coordinates (no more int.MinValue UnknownCoord sentinel). v0.6.1 (previous) fixed a shipped database-merge crash where the Builder Assistant .xdb reused the same Class-parameter GUID across multiple block-behavior nodes; every parameter now carries a unique GUID and the independent speedboat data is left byte-identical. v0.6 keeps the independent speedboat prototype (behavior unchanged) and the offline auto-building cottage foundation with per-cell failure classification, bounded frame-wait for chunks still generating, and rollback/undo that track and retry deferred cells instead of silently reporting a clean finish. Verified so far by offline Core+Generators logic tests (72/72) and XDB merge-safety guard tests (7/7); the game-adapter layer and Android single-player behavior are still 待验证 (pending real-device verification).
Author: godblessmezyan-art
